name: a spawned session working is not news
why: The user never opened this terminal and is not watching it, so progress from a background session is noise by definition. This stream even includes a failing test count — attention-grade for a watched session — and it still stays quiet, because the session is working the failure unwatched and will raise its own permission or error if it needs a human.

events.text: The failure is in the token refresh path. Narrowing it down now.
